956.zh: 尽管前年市场环境恶劣，该企业仍凭借卓越的创新能力实现了逆势增长。
956.en: Despite the harsh market environment the year before last, the enterprise still achieved counter-trend growth through excellent innovation capabilities.

957.en: Please help me buy a bottle of mineral water.

957.zh: 为了保证饮水安全，大家习惯购买品牌矿泉水。
957.en: To ensure drinking water safety, people are accustomed to purchasing branded mineral water.

957.zh: 这种矿泉水富含多种对人体有益的微量元素，深受消费者青睐。
957.en: This type of mineral water is rich in various trace elements beneficial to the human body and is highly favored by consumers.

958.zh: 请把这些书搬家去图书馆。
958.en: Please move these books to the library.

958.zh: 搬家的时候，他卖掉了大部分家具。
958.en: When moving house, he sold most of the furniture.

958.zh: 由于房东要收回房屋，我们不得不仓促搬家。
958.en: Since the landlord wants to reclaim the property, we have to move house in a hurry.

959.en: He is taking photos in the park.

959.zh: 这台相机的性能非常出色，特别适合在野外照相。
959.en: This camera has excellent performance, making it especially suitable for taking photos in the wild.

959.zh: 他非常喜欢旅游，每到一个地方都喜欢照相留念。
959.en: He loves traveling very much, and he likes to take photos to commemorate every place he visits.

960.zh: 如果你有时间，我们可以一起去参观动物园。
960.en: If you have time, we can visit the zoo together.

960.zh: 动物园里有两只大熊猫。
960.en: There are two giant pandas in the zoo.

960.zh: 为了保护野生生物，动物园采取了许多科学的管理措施。
960.en: In order to protect wildlife, the zoo has adopted many scientific management measures.

961.en: I want to drink water, I am thirsty.
Drinking more water can eliminate thirst.
He drinks water to dull his thirst.

962.zh: 这位教授很出名，学术界的人大多认得他。
962.en: This professor is very famous; most people in the academic circle know him.

962.zh: 作为业内的权威，他认得很多重要的合作伙伴。
962.en: As an authority in the industry, he knows many important business partners.

963.en: Are you the person entertaining the guests?

963.zh: 他特意打电话邀请我请客。
963.en: He specifically called to invite me to dinner.

963.zh: 他在豪宅里举办了一场奢华的请客宴会。
963.en: He hosted a luxurious dinner party in his mansion.

964.zh: 经过努力，他的年级排名提高了。
964.en: Through hard work, his grade ranking has improved.
He is in third grade at school.

964.zh: 该年级的学术氛围十分浓厚。
964.en: The academic atmosphere of this year group is very strong.

965.en: I want to buy a pair of shorts.

965.zh: 由于运动量大，他选择穿透气的短裤。
965.en: Due to the high intensity of exercise, he chose to wear breathable shorts.

965.zh: 为了方便行动，探险队成员大多穿上了轻便的短裤。
965.en: For ease of movement, most of the expedition members put on lightweight shorts.

966.zh: 如果你不预习课文，就很难听懂老师讲的内容。
966.en: If you don't preview the text, it will be hard to understand what the teacher is explaining.

966.zh: 老师希望我们加强对课文的理解。
966.en: The teacher hopes we will reinforce our understanding of the text.

967.en: The dish on this plate is delicious.

967.zh: 他小心地端着摆满酒杯的盘子。
967.en: He carefully carried a tray filled with wine glasses.

967.zh: 服务员托着沉重的盘子穿过大厅。
967.en: The waiter carried the heavy tray through the hall.

968.en: Can we eat a bit later?

968.zh: 由于天气原因，我的行程晚点了。
968.en: Due to the weather, my trip is behind schedule.

968.zh: 这趟公共汽车晚点了二十分钟。
968.en: This bus is delayed by twenty minutes.

969.en: The takeout has arrived at home.

969.zh: 为了增加营业额，老板决定外卖。
969.en: To increase turnover, the boss decided to provide takeout.

969.zh: 比起亲自下厨，他更倾向于通过手机订购外卖。
969.en: Compared to cooking for himself, he prefers ordering takeout via mobile phone.

970.en: The music here is unpleasant to hear.

970.zh: 如果你不预习课文，就很难听懂老师讲的内容。
970.en: If you don't preview the text, it will be hard to understand what the teacher is explaining.

970.zh: 这声音太难听了，请关掉。
970.en: This sound is too unpleasant; please turn it off.

971.zh: 这本词典收录了许多现代汉语词汇。
971.en: This dictionary contains many modern Chinese vocabulary words.

971.zh: 这部词典编纂得非常严谨，学术价值很高。
971.en: This dictionary is compiled very rigorously and has high academic value.

972.zh: 老师用粉笔在黑板上演示了解题过程。
972.en: The teacher used chalk to demonstrate the problem-solving process on the blackboard.

973.en: Do you have a new toothbrush?

973.zh: 你应该每天早晚换牙刷吗？不，你应该每三个月换一次牙刷。
973.en: Should you change your toothbrush every morning and evening? No, you should change your toothbrush every three months.
He bought a new toothbrush holder.

974.zh: 为了完成这项任务，大家必须团结一致，一块儿努力。
974.en: In order to complete this task, everyone must unite and work hard together.

974.zh: 我和我的朋友一块儿看电影。
974.en: My friend and I are watching a movie together.

974.zh: 既然我们志同道合，不如一块儿携手共进，去实现我们的理想。
974.en: Since we share common goals, why don't we join hands and move forward together to realize our ideals?

975.zh: 我不认识这个汉字，请查查字典。
975.en: I don't know this Chinese character; please look it up in the dictionary.

975.zh: 查字典看这个字的语音。
975.en: Check the dictionary for the colloquial pronunciation of this character.

975.zh: 作为一名翻译，我经常需要参考权威的字典。
975.en: As a translator, I often need to consult authoritative dictionaries.

976.en: Watch the traffic lights when crossing.

977.en: I like ice cream in summer.
Give me a strawberry ice cream.

978.en: She eats soup with a spoon.
The spoon is beside the bowl.

979.zh: 高铁改变了人们的生活方式。
979.en: High-speed rail has changed people's lifestyle.
I plan to take the high-speed rail to Beijing.

979.zh: 高铁的普及极大地促进了区域间的经济交流与合作。
979.en: The popularization of high-speed rail has greatly promoted economic exchange and cooperation between regions.

980.en: Go under the tree to cool off a bit.
Cool off by blowing the electric fan.

980.zh: 外边在下雨，我们反而觉得很凉快。
980.en: It is raining outside, but on the contrary, we feel quite cool.

981.en: It is raining, hurry up and put on your raincoat.

981.zh: 虽然外面在下大雨，但他还是穿上雨衣骑自行车出发了。
981.en: Although it is raining heavily outside, he still put on a raincoat and set off on his bicycle.

981.zh: 由于长期暴露在潮湿的环境中，他的雨衣已经出现了明显的磨损迹象。
981.en: Due to long-term exposure to a humid environment, his raincoat has already shown obvious signs of wear.

982.en: I heard he is going to get married the year after next.
We want to go traveling the year after next.

982.zh: 按照计划，后年我们将举办国际学术会议。
982.en: According to the plan, we will hold an international academic conference the year after next.

983.zh: 下课以后，我们去咖啡馆聊天儿吧。
983.en: Let's go to the cafe to chat after class.

983.zh: 爷爷每天早上都去茶馆儿聊天儿。
983.en: Grandpa goes to the teahouse to chat every morning.

984.zh: 除了这些条件，你还有别的要求吗？
984.en: Besides these conditions, do you have any other requests?

984.zh: 我们去别的地方看看吧。
984.en: Let's go look at other places.

984.zh: 除了这双鞋以外，我没有别的了。
984.en: Except for this pair of shoes, I have no others.

985.en: Don't be anxious, I will go to school.

985.zh: 他的沉默让在场的人都感到有些担心。
985.en: His silence made everyone present feel a bit uneasy.

985.zh: 许多父母为子女的未来感到担心。
985.en: Many parents feel worried about their children's future.

986.zh: 要是你觉得累的话，就先休息一会儿。
986.en: If you feel tired, then rest for a while first.
If you are happy, then I am happy.
I understood what the teacher said.

987.zh: 我常在手机上看电子书。
987.en: I often read e-books on my phone.

987.zh: 这本电子书可以免费下载。
987.en: This e-book is free to download.

988.en: He had a fever yesterday and didn't go to school.

988.zh: 他不仅发烧书法，还发烧画画。
988.en: He is not only fascinated with calligraphy but also painting.

988.zh: 新兴市场的经济表现呈现出极其发烧的态势。
988.en: The economic performance of emerging markets shows a flourishing trend.

989.en: Tickets must be checked before boarding.

990.en: The doctor turned on the machine to work.

990.zh: 工程师检查后，成功将发动机开机。
990.en: After inspection, the engineer successfully started the engine.

990.zh: 当系统响应迟钝时，应执行开机指令。
990.en: When the system response is sluggish, execute a hard reset command.

991.zh: 他坐在面试官面前，显得非常有自信。
991.en: He sat facing the interviewer, appearing very confident.

991.zh: 我不喜欢在别人面前说话。
991.en: I don't like to speak in front of others.

991.zh: 大家在法律面前是平等的。
991.en: Everyone is equal before the law.

992.zh: 我用银行卡在超市买东西。
992.en: I use my bank card to buy things at the supermarket.

992.zh: 由于密码输入错误，他的银行卡被暂时冻结了。
992.en: Due to an incorrect password entry, his bank card was temporarily frozen.

992.zh: 为了防止个人财产受损，请务必妥善保管好您的银行卡。
992.en: In order to prevent personal property loss, please make sure to keep your bank card safe.

993.zh: 虽然周末很忙，但我还是想去公园散步。
993.en: Although I am very busy on the weekend, I still want to go for a walk in the park.

993.zh: 周末我常和朋友一起去外面吃饭。
993.en: I often go out to eat with friends on weekends.

993.zh: 这个周末我们一起去成功旅游。
993.en: Let's go travel to Chenggong together this weekend.
